items.title: Over 850 stocks fall as US inflation fears rattle Bursa Malaysia
items.summary: KUALA LUMPUR: Bursa Malaysia closed broadly lower on Thursday, with more than 800 stocks ending in the red as hotter-than-expected US inflation fuelled concerns over further Federal Reserve interest rate hikes, triggering a sell-off across regional markets.

items.title: UBS extends Fed tightening cycle forecast with March rate hike after inflation surprise
items.summary: UBS Global Wealth Management expects the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates for a third time in March 2027, extending its tightening cycle into next year after stronger-than-expected September...

items.title: US labour market remains stuck in low-hire, low-fire state as inflation intensifies: Fed
items.summary: The Federal Reserve's latest Beige Book highlights persistent inflation pressures and a stagnant US labour market, with rising energy, tariff, and insurance costs hitting businesses. With September consumer inflation rising 3.7%, expectations are growing for another potential interest rate hike at the Fed's upcoming October meeting.

items.title: Gold rebounds from one-week low as dollar slips
items.summary: GOLD prices edged higher on Thursday, rebounding from a one-week low hit in the previous session, as the US dollar eased, while investors assessed the likelihood of a Federal Reserve interest rate increase this month after a hot inflation report.

items.title: Global Market: Citi expects Fed to raise rates by 25 basis points in December after hot US inflation data
items.summary: Citigroup now expects the US Federal Reserve to raise interest rates by 25 basis points in December following hotter-than-expected September inflation. The brokerage forecasts rates to remain unchanged thereafter, with rate cuts unlikely before June 2027.

items.title: Inflation anxiety drags on AI stocks for a second day as markets point to a mixed open
items.summary: Trading on Wall Street is mixed early with tech stocks poised for more declines as earnings season ramps up amid the latest government data showing that inflation remains a problem in the U.S. Futures for the S&P 500 were down 0.2% before the opening bell Thursday, while futures for the Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 0.3%. Nasdaq futures tumbled 1%. Artificial intelligence stocks were down again after taking a beating a day earlier. A government inflation report on Wednesday showed that prices remain well above the Federal Reserve’s 2% target, putting in play another potential interest rate hike before the end of the year.

items.title: KOSPI crashes 8%, Nikkei down 4% as Asian markets feel the AI sell
items.summary: Asian markets tumble as a global chip sell-off rout and United States inflation data spark fears of further Federal Reserve interest rate hikes.

items.title: Sensex Today | Stock Market LIVE Updates: GIFT Nifty hints a muted start; US, Asian markets decline
items.summary: Sensex Today | Stock Market LIVE Updates: Hotter-than-expected inflation data sent the Nasdaq ​to a sharply lower close on Wednesday, with worries about more interest rate hikes from the Federal Reserve pummeling ‌shares of Oracle, CoreWeave and other AI stocks sensitive to higher borrowing costs. The S&P 500 declined 1.11% to end the session at 7,718.94 points, its biggest one-day drop since July 29. The Nasdaq declined 1.88% to ​26,692.87 points, its biggest daily drop since July 23. The Dow Jones Industrial Average declined 0.09% to 51,621.48 points.

items.title: Ringgit opens lower vs US dollar on renewed US rate hike expectations
items.summary: KUALA LUMPUR: The ringgit opened lower against the US dollar on Thursday as stronger-than-expected US inflation data bolstered expectations of a possible interest rate increase by the US Federal Reserve (Fed), lending support to the greenback.
